[[File:ZayneAndGryphHologram-DT11.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The appearance of Zayne Carrick and Gryph from a hologram in 19 BBY.]]
'''Marn Hierogryph's hologram''' was a holographic recording that [[Marn Hierogryph|Marn "Gryph" Hierogryph]] made after he and [[Zayne Carrick]] encountered the [[Muur Talisman]] on the planet [[Jebble]] in [[3963 BBY]]. Gryph created the recording in order to preserve his memoirs, although he twisted some of the details in order to enhance his contributions to the events he encountered. [[Zayne Carrick]] saw the opportunity to use it as a part of his plan to help clean up his name from an accusation in the [[Padawan Massacre]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. [[Darth Malak|Alek]] [[Squinquargesimus]] and [[Shel Jelavan]] sent a transmission of the recording to [[Vandar Tokare]], the only member of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] Zayne could trust, to enlighten him on the events that really happened on Jebble. Vandar was convinced and decided to meet Squinquargesimus and Jelavan in person.<ref name="KOTOR 31">[[Knights of the Old Republic 31|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 31]]</ref><ref name="JJM notes">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor31.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #31''}}</ref>

The hologram eventually ended up in a cache of artifacts, mostly containing gems and precious metals, on the planet of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. It attracted the attention of historian [[Fane Peturri]] as he used the hologram to research [[Dreypa's Oubliette]] and the [[Muur Talisman]]. Upon obtaining the previous two items in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Peturri showed a segment of the hologram to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].<ref name="Dark Times 11">[[Dark Times 11|''Dark Times'' 11]]</ref>
